user_stories.title: Add AllowedPythonDirs text input field to TUI model
acceptance_criteria: Field inAllowedPythonDirs added to model struct after inSafeScriptDirs
Field added to settingsInputNames array as "allowedpythondirs"
Field initialized in initSettingsInputs() with joinPaths(cfg.AllowedPythonDirs)
Field added to settingsInputs map with pointer reference
Field added to blurAllInputs() function
Code compiles without type errors
user_stories.notes: Follows exact pattern of inSafeScriptDirs field. Uses mkInput helper with placeholder "Allowed Python dirs (path-separated)" and width 80.

user_stories.title: Wire AllowedPythonDirs field to settings navigation
acceptance_criteria: Field added to settingsGrid map at position {14, 0} (new row below safescriptdirs)
Focus case added to focusInput() function for "allowedpythondirs"
Arrow keys can navigate to the field
Tab key cycles through the field
Field shows visual focus indicator when active
user_stories.notes: Grid position row 14 chosen for vertical layout in Security group. Alternative is row 13, column 1 for horizontal layout.

user_stories.title: Connect AllowedPythonDirs field to config system
acceptance_criteria: Getter/setter added to inputFieldAccessors map in keys_settings.go
Config population added to populateConfigFromInputs() using parsePathList()
Existing allowed_python_dirs values load from config on TUI startup
Changes to field save to config.yaml when Ctrl+S pressed
Field values persist across TUI restarts
user_stories.notes: Uses existing parsePathList() helper which handles OS-specific path separators (colon on Unix, semicolon on Windows).

user_stories.title: Render AllowedPythonDirs field in Settings view
acceptance_criteria: Field rendered in Security group below SafeScriptDirs field
Both fields use vertical layout with JoinVertical
Security box highlights when either field is focused
isInSettingsGroup includes both "safescriptdirs" and "allowedpythondirs"
Layout displays correctly in terminal
user_stories.notes: Modifies renderSecurityGroup() function to include both fields in the security box content.
